title: RWUSD Updates: Now Supported as a Margin Asset on Binance Futures
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. USDT is not available to users in EEA regions. Fellow Binancians, Binance Earn is excited to announce that  RWUSD  can now be used as a margin asset in USDⓈ-M Futures trading under both  Multi-Assets Mode  and  Portfolio Margin Mode . This upgrade allows users to utilize their RWUSD holdings as the margin assets for Futures trading while continuing to earn up to  4% APR  rewards. Key Highlights Earn While Trading:  Continue to earn daily RWUSD 4% APR rewards on your margin balance in your USDⓈ-M Futures account to increase capital efficiency. Supported Modes:  RWUSD is supported as a margin asset in both  Multi-Assets Mode  and  Portfolio Margin Mode . Portfolio Margin Mode Collateral Ratio Portfolio Margin Mode Collateral Ratio:  RWUSD’s Collateral Value Ratio as USDⓈ-M Futures Margin is  99.9%. Tiered Collateral Ratio of Portfolio Margin Pro mode: Asset Floor Cap Collateral Ratio RWUSD 0 1,200,000 99.9% 1,200,000 2,000,000 97.5% > 2,000,000 - 0% Maximum Transfer Limits for Multi-Assets Mode: VIP level Maximum Limit per Master or Sub-Account (in RWUSD) 0 50,000 1 200,000 2 300,000 3 400,000 4 500,000 5 600,000 6 700,000 7 800,000 8 900,000 9 1,000,000 How to Use RWUSD as Futures Margin Subscribe  USDT  or  USDC  to  RWUSD  via Binance Earn. Transfer your RWUSD from your Spot account to your USDⓈ-M Futures account. On the Futures trading interface, activate  Multi-Assets Mode  or apply for the  Portfolio Margin Program . Your RWUSD balance will now contribute to your margin assets, and you can start trading USDⓈ-M contracts. Explore with RWUSD Now! About RWUSD: RWUSD is a principal-protected yield product that offers users flexible-term subscriptions with daily APR rewards. The APR is determined at Binance’s discretion and aims to benchmark yields in RWAs such as tokenized US Treasury Bills. RWUSD is the record of your subscribed assets and any accrued rewards with Binance only. It is not a stablecoin, security, fund, tokenized RWA, or on-chain asset, and it does not represent any user right to any RWAs.  Related Materials What is RWUSD RWUSD Updates: Enjoy an Increased Quota of 15 Million with 4.2% APR Rewards Binance Upgrades VIP Investor Program to Include RWUSD RWUSD: SAPI Endpoints Now Available What is Multi-Assets Mode Introduction to the Portfolio Margin Mode Please Note: Changes to the RWUSD Rewards Rate will be published on the Platform from time to time. Please refer to  Binance RWUSD Terms and Conditions   and  Risk Warning   for more information prior to using the RWUSD services.  By subscribing to RWUSD, you will be allocated RWUSD (1:1 in exchange for your Stablecoin Assets) and earn daily APR rewards in RWUSD. Qualified global users can subscribe to RWUSD with USDT, whereas eligible users in the EEA region can subscribe using USDC. RWUSD is not a stablecoin, security, fund, tokenized RWA, or on-chain asset, and it does no t represent any user right to any RWAs. It is not available to U.S. persons. If the user’s margin balance is below the initial margin, there will be no available RWUSD to be transferred to the Spot account.  RWUSD cannot be used as a margin asset for Coin-M Futures, Grid Trading and Copy Trading . When liquidation happens to an user’s UM account with RWUSD as margin asset, Auto-Exchange might happen. For more information, please refer to these FAQs:  Frequently Asked Questions on the Multi-Assets Mode What Is Multi-Assets Mode and Which Assets Are Supported RWUSD cannot be used as collateral for Binance Margin. RWUSD can only be redeemed to USDC from users’ Spot account. To redeem RWUSD  in a Future’s account, users need to first transfer the RWUSD to their Spot account.
